title: Chris Kelly double-booking jobs and sending substitutes
summary: Kelly took deposits on two jobs and sent a substitute trumpeter, which disgusted Barnes.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: I don't know what it is. To change the subject, did Chris Kelly ever use two trumpets?
No. Not, not, not in one day.
Well what would you do when he'd blow you up like that? Yeah. What would you do when he'd blow you up?
Well he, he would notify me.
He, and he'd send them a hammer.
He'd send a, he'd send somebody with me and he'd go on another job where he had deposit on a, on them jobs, you see.
Who did he send in this place?

Well he'd pick up just who he could get, what he could, somebody he could cheat. See, he'd take, he'd take that job, he'd be done, got, I'd be done, get him a deposit on a job, you know. And he'd take another job, you see. And he'd take another band and get a trumpet player and send with me. Sometimes he'd send a good one, sometimes he'd just send somebody not used to playing with the band. Well that's what got me disgusted.
